description: Detach a channel from an agent, ending the binding attach_channel made. The channel itself stays in the organization for other agents. The agent stops receiving the channel's events, which is the intended outcome. Detaching a channel that is not attached changes nothing. Slack detaches by removing the agent's Slack app, so for Slack this gives the step to take and detaches nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account.

channel.description: The name the channel is attached under, from list_channels.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the agent belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: detach_channel

agent.description: Name of the agent the call acted on.

already.description: True when the channel was already in this state before the call, so nothing changed. Absent when this call changed it.

attached.description: True when the channel is attached to the agent after the call, false when it is not. attach_channel always reports true; detach_channel always reports false.

channel.description: Name the channel is attached under, which is the name detach_channel takes.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.
Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

step.description: What the person does in a browser, such as authorizing a service. Nothing has changed until they do it.

url.description: Address of the page where the person finishes the step. Absent when the page has no address to give.

title: Detach a channel
